name: Alexander Blockx
intro: Alexander Blockx is a tall young player from Antwerp, Belgium. He is only 21. He is already the best player in his country.
story: Alexander started tennis at age four. He tagged along to his big brother's lessons. The coach asked if the little guy wanted to try. He said yes. He never stopped. In 2023 he won the Australian Open junior title. This year he made the semifinals of a big event in Madrid.

funFacts.text: His dad was a hurdle runner. His mom was a swimmer.
He is a tennis trivia whiz. He can recall old match scores from memory.
As a kid fan, he got a photo with Daniil Medvedev. Now they share stages.
He had the same coach from age 4 until this year. That's 16 years!
He won 42 of 45 matches in under-12 tournaments.
He beat Learner Tien to win the 2023 Australian Open boys' title.
He is 6 feet 4 inches tall. That's a lot of reach!

watchFor: Watch his booming serve. He is very tall. The ball comes down fast and bounces high.
